title: Panorama, partly cloudy day
desc: The real skyline renderer at 128: the 64 scene in the middle, the South Loop added on the left and the Gold Coast stepping down to the lake on the right. Clouds, sun, windows and ripples come from the same payload.

title: Panorama, dusk
desc: Dusk: the sun sets behind the Loop as the windows come on.

title: Panorama, clear night
desc: Clear night: twice the stars, the pier lit, the wheel cycling color.

title: Panorama, snowy night
desc: Snow on every roof, flakes across the whole width.

title: Skyline with a big clock
desc: The 64 scene kept at the left; the right half is open lake and sky, with the clock in the big digits.
note: Keeps the existing art; only the sky and water get wider.

title: Seventies swoosh
desc: The stripes run along the bottom, climb, and run along the top to the right edge. Time on the left; the weekday in full, then the date and temperature, under the top run.

title: Analog + calendar
desc: The analog face as it is, with the month beside it and today highlighted.
note: The calendar replaces the face's date and temperature; five week rows fill the height, so there's no weekday header.

title: Word clock at 64
desc: The same idea in 64 columns: 16 letters by 5 rows, words run together and share letters (SEVENINEIGHTWO), as on physical word clocks. 9:42 PM lights TWENTY, TO, TEN and PM.
note: Drops IT IS and MINUTES. W is drawn 3 px wide to fit the 4 px grid; the board font has it at 5.

title: Word clock
desc: Every word stays faintly on the grid; the ones that tell the time light up. 9:42 PM reads TWENTY MINUTES TO TEN.
note: A new face rather than a widened one. Rounds to five minutes.
